Soc. 65: 111–123), Carl Wunderlich (1868 Das Verhalten der Eigenwärme in Krankheiten), Henry Barbour (1912), Paul Beeson (1948), and Matthew Kluger (1975 Science 188: 166–168) shows 1) Heat loss via sweat evaporation (580 cal / 2,428 J per gram of water) + skin vasodilation vs heat production via shivering + vasoconstriction; 2) Wunderlich's 37.0 °C (98.6 °F) daily circadian curve; and 3) White blood cell pyrogens (IL-1 → PGE₂) shifting the anterior hypothalamic set-point from 37 °C to 39 °C.
